The six ability scores of a creature, as integers 1-30: str, dex, con, int, wis, cha. The modifier for a score is floor((score - 10) / 2) and is ALWAYS derived, never stored here. Change one score with component.merge; component.set would discard the other five. Governed by procedure.mechanic.dnd2024.abilities. Source: System Reference Document 5.2.1, 'Playing the Game - Ability Scores', Wizards of the Coast, CC-BY-4.0, https://www.dndbeyond.com/srd

The single authoritative Initiative order for one encounter: participants in acting order, highest count first, with the derived Initiative count each rolled and the fixed SRD 5.2.1 source reference. Attach it to the encounter entity only, never to a participant. Written by mechanic.dnd2024.encounter-initiative-order through component.add, so a second write fails rather than silently replacing the order. It stores no ability scores, modifiers, raw dice, rounds, turns, conditions, or duplicate roster; the roster is the encounter's containment and the replay seed is recorded exactly in the action audit. Governed by procedure.mechanic.dnd2024.encounter-initiative-order.
